summary: A test for worker deployment version ramp-up is flaky, intermittently failing when the expected version doesn't match the actual version after task distribution.
userImpact: Flaky tests in the CI pipeline reduce code quality confidence and can intermittently block releases.
rootCause: Race condition or timing issue in worker deployment version switching during task distribution, causing version state inconsistency.
resolutionDetails: Addressed the race condition in worker deployment versioning logic to ensure consistent task distribution during version ramp-up.
